description: Governor's Secretariat - Sabaragamuwa - Revenue-Expenditure Estimates from 01.01.2020 up to 31.12.2020
categorisation: This gazette content focuses exclusively on government structural and administrative changes related to provincial council financial operations. It details the authorization of expenditures, revenue estimates, and financial provisions for the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council under the Provincial Council Act No. 42 of 1987. While it mentions the Governor granting permission, it does not name any specific individuals beyond the generic title "Hon. Governor" and does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities of any person. The content is purely about administrative functions, budget allocations, and financial procedures without personnel appointments or detailed ministerial portfolios.
